The building-to-city rule and Berlin being a city in Germany are firm, as in the DL file; fact ids, gives_up and worlds are the DL file's. Paris observing CET is the stored bridge.

building_rule.says: A building observes the time zone of the city it stands in.
building_rule.z3: ForAll([b, c], Implies(And(located_in(b, c), city(c)), in_time_zone(b) == in_time_zone(c)))
